messages:
jess-sales: Quick escalation 
Argentum Health POC stalled. They require formal BYO-KMS attestation, 7-year audit retention, and a committed pricing path before execs will sign. Need triage and a short list for the bridge.
omar-se: Do we have the questionnaire link? I can map the answers once I see exact wording.
jess-sales: Uploaded here: https://files.argentum/sec-qa-2026.pdf. Their top asks: BYO-KMS with HSM attestation, explicit "no vendor key access" language, regional egress control, and p99 latency SLA of 99.9% for their test profile.
tara-eng: Their test profile: 1.1k concurrent streams, avg token length ~450. To hit p99 we need Dedicated + pinned model and specific batching config.
ben-ops: For BYO-KMS we need peering + customer IAM principal + acceptance of the KMS endpoint IPs. Also recommend a feature flag for KMS failover; ops cannot enable transparent fallback without a toggle.
sam-ciso: We will need an HSM attestation doc and a separation-of-control diagram. Legal will want precise wording on "no vendor access" vs emergency breakglass.
rebecca-legal: I can draft an attestation addendum. Please provide a 1-page tech note from infra describing how keys are proxied and where audit logs are stored.
finance-bot: Preliminary pricing: for a 12mo committed baseline we can offer 20% off list with an additional tiered rebate for sustained >1k qps over a 30-day window. Exact numbers to follow.
omar-se: Draft security responses: BYO-KMS supported on Private/Dedicated; keys remain in customer KMS; no plaintext keys stored on hosts; rotation handled by customer. Audit logs can be forwarded to customer storage.
sam-ciso: That draft looks ok. Add mention of attestation: we can provide HSM certificate chain and an infra diagram proving keys are never imported into vendor control plane.
ben-ops: Ops will produce runbook steps: detect KMS failure, raise alert, and (if feature-flag enabled) initiate a controlled failover to hosted key variant. We will also emit metrics (kms.failover_count, kms.timeout_secs).
rebecca-legal: For the addendum suggest wording: "Vendor has no routine access to customer-managed keys. Emergency access requires written customer approval and is logged and auditable." LMK if security wants stronger language.
sam-ciso: That should be acceptable; add an appendix with attestation artifacts. Also confirm log retention approach: we can push to customer S3/GCS with configurable retention up to 7 years.
tara-eng: I'll produce a 1-page diagram + sample config snippet (allowlist and kms_endpoint) and a brief performance note indicating the pinned model and instance sizing to meet p99.
jess-sales: Action items for exec bridge (scheduled by ops): 1) Omar finalize sec Q&A; 2) Tara produce infra diagram + perf notes; 3) Ben add runbook + feature-flag PR; 4) Rebecca draft addendum; 5) Finance final pricing table. Please update this thread with links.
ben-ops: Scheduling exec bridge: #exec-argentum-bridge 2026-06-02 15:00 UTC. Bridge invite sent.
jess-sales: Thanks all 64f I'll prep the slides. If we can deliver these items prior to the bridge we should clear the blocker.
omar-se: Will post Q&A doc by EOD.
rebecca-legal: Addendum first pass tomorrow AM.
finance-bot: Pricing table ETA tomorrow afternoon.
ben-ops: Runbook PR targeted tomorrow AM; will include flag and metrics.
tara-eng: Diagram and perf notes by EOD.
jess-sales: Closing for now, will reopen if blockers surface. :thumbsup:
